description: Returns up to 8 open times in the next 7 days for a free strategy call with the Hire Overseas team, each with a booking link, plus a general booking link. With lead_token the links are prefilled with the user's verified name and email. Show the times in the user's timezone and let them pick; booking happens on the Calendly page the link opens.

lead_token.description: Optional. The leadToken from verify_email, once the user has verified their work email. Unlocks the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé text and candidate page (branded résumé and intro video) and uses the verified email.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone for the time labels, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Defaults to UTC.

name: get_booking_slots
title: Find a time for a call with Hire Overseas
